nom: Perricone MD High Potency Hyaluronic Intensive Hydrating Serum

avis.titre: Best serum for dry sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I have been using this serum for about 40 days now and I am in love! This is the most hydrating serum I've tried and I've tried many! It goes on almost like a light moisturizer gel, but instantly melts into your skin and it makes your actual moisturizer really penetrate and last longer. I have dry, sensitive skin year round, and this serum will be in rotation throughout. Fantastic product! It's also unscented, not sticky, actually does show a difference the first time you use it and a bottle lasts a long while.

avis.titre: Works well with the toner and moisturizer.
avis.texte: I use this serum every day after my Pericone Toner. I don't want to be without it. My skin tends to be very dry.

Incredibly rich, hydrating serum. It was perfect as a daily boost for my dry winter skin. As the weather has warmed up, I've found it a bit heavy. I look forward to pulling it out again in a few months when my skin needs another hydrating, plumping boost.
Made my skin greasy. I currently use only a light weight moisturizer on my face. Tried this under my moisturizer and felt like my face was so greasy all day.

I love this!!! It feels so hydrating when you apply and I feel like after a month of use I have more of a glow. It rubs in nicely and for a minute seems a bit greasy but it soaks in wonderfully. I have combo skin and I feel like it works well, helping the dry spots but not making the oily spots worse! I love the pump dispenser, one pump goes a long way!
The product is amazing and it helps with any skin type issue you have and it leaves your skin amazing smooth and will hydrate your skin as well. My skin didnt have a reaction to it at all.

This hyaluronic serum has more of a lightweight cream consistency to it which I find moisturizing. It has replaced both my hyaluronic acid and niacinimide serum. I like how there's no scent and it absorbs quickly. It layers easily under a moisturizer and doesn't impact the way my makeup is applied over it. There's no fragrance and it doesn't cause any irritation or breakouts. I really like the glass bottle and pump too.

Normally hyaluronic acid is not my favorite active ingredient, but this formulation is really nice. It is a very thick gel texture that glides over the skin super smoothly, yet somehow doesn't have that silicone residue that pulls up on so.e other products. I do feel that this is very plumping to my dry skin. I recommend using this after an essence to really lock in that moisture and plumpness. I will use this up.

Initially I didn't think a product of this consistency would do much to hydrate my patchy skin but I've been pleasantly surprised. I have combination skin and my oily areas don't get any less/more oily and I noticed a difference in my dry areas. Over all I've been pleasantly surprised

This serum is a thick silky type texture that smooths over your skin and leaves it super hydrated and plump. I enjoy the pump dispenser and they do give you a generous amount in the bottle. My skin reacted great with it. Highly recommend this serum.

I received this product in exchange for my honest opinion. I've been trying various beauty brands trying to find the right ones for my aging skin. I have several hyaluronic serums in my beauty regimen, but I find myself reaching for this most often. The packaging is sleek and nice. I can tell a visible difference in my skin. It's not dull and lifeless anymore. Will definitely be buying!

This serum is everything. I've been battling dry skin on my face since giving birth and this has helped me in the hydration disturb department. I use it under my moisturizer and is been working wonders. Not sure u can afford long term but in will continue to buy as long as I can

avis.titre: Hydrating Serum for a fresh face
avis.texte: I absolutely loved this product! I'm going thru a period where my skin feels dry and I love to use product that moisturize but don't make my skin look or feel oily. This serum did just that! I used it twice daily under moisturizer and I felt like my skin soaked up all of the benefits and showed throughout the day. My makeup went on smoothly and my bare skin was clear and looked more refreshed. I will definitely be continuing the use of this product. PERRICONE MD did it again!

avis.titre: Noticeable Improvement in Fine Lines After 2 Weeks
avis.texte: Perricone MD High potency Hyaluronic Intensive Hydrating Serum is among the best products I've ever used. After two weeks I started noticing a difference in how my skin felt, and after a month the fine lines were less noticeable. The serum absorbs quite fast and truly has a luxurious feel. The scent is subtle and very pleasant. Overall I'm so impressed with the serum and its results. I'll definitely use this again.

avis.titre: Great serum for rejuvenating your skin
avis.texte: Took me couple weeks to see instant results, no drying but infect it hydrated, moisturized my skin, and reduced appearance of fine lines & wrinkles. I used on neck and face .

avis.titre: Love this moisturizing serum that balances my skin
avis.texte: This serum is moisturizing and just makes my skin feel so balanced and great. It is a refreshing relief to apply it after acids and or retinol and before my regular night moisturizer. I also use it in the morning after vitamind c serum and before spf. It is a great addition to my routine that I didn't know I needed but it really does just improve the overall quality and moisture level of my skin. I would repurchase!!

avis.titre: A favorite for hydrating older skin
avis.texte: An all time favorite brand. Smooth texture. Does Mae skin feel hydrated and firmer. Use as directed and can seem subtle changes. I use it all over face and neck. Look the packaging of the glass amber bottle and the pump nozzle.
This stuff is great. It doesn't feel oily on my skin or cause any irritation. The pump and bottle are nice and there isn't residue left on my hands or pillow afterwards.

I love the Perricone MD intensive hydrating serum. It reduces redness around my nose, where I have a lot of uneven skin tone from my years in the sun. It is creamier than a standard serum, and glides on skin very smoothly without feeling sticky.
Very hydrating and smooth in the skin. A little goes a long way for my aging skin. Easily dispensable and gentle on my sensitive skin. Good hydrating ingredients.

I love this serum, the texture is very soft. Melts right into the skin, without leaving a sticky residue. I use it under my sunscreen, skin feels hydrated for the whole day. It also gives a nice glow to my skin.

I've been using this serum for a week+ now and it's one of these quickest I've noticed a change. My skin gets dry and this product is lightweight but very nourishing. There is no slick feeling. My skin looks smoother and feels more hydrated. A little goes a long way, so I don't feel wasteful with the product! The only downside is the price point but if you're looking to invest this is worth it!

The packing is dark and sleek. I could only apply on the flat areas of my face: cheeks, forehead etc. I found irrigation around my nose and Clift in my chin due to its high potency. Once I realized this, I had no problems other than glowing skin!

avis.titre: Good, but not the only option
avis.texte: The bottle is a lovely brown glass, which I love. The pump…actually works! Always a huge plus. I like the slightly different than usual pump, as well. I think it helps it work better. Also, the stop that comes with it is great for travel, so you don't accidentally get moisturizer everywhere in your bag. It goes on easily, absorbs pretty quickly, and does hydrate my skin very well. I've used it both day and night. It hydrates well over night, and isn't greasy during the day. I can also put my SPF over it without any issues. With all that said, I have another moisturizer that has many of the same ingredients, moisturizes my skin really well both day and night, and is a much larger bottle for a much lower cost. I have zero problem paying for a quality product, but with my lower end product working so well, this one would have to provide miracle work to get me to commit. Maybe once I finish the entire bottle I will change my mind? Only time will tell.

avis.titre: Causes pilling with other moisturizing products
avis.texte: The consistency is quite thick for a serum. It is almost like a serum and a light moisturizer in one. However, I have dry skin so I need to use a moisturizer along with it. The issue with that is that it can pill when used with other serums and moisturizers.
Extremely hydrating. Goes on smoothly, saturates my skin and gives it a wonderful glow. My skin feels moisturized and soft. It's name doesn't lie, intensely hydrating for sure!

avis.titre: Feels nice on my normal to dry skin
avis.texte: Has a nice light feel on the skin and absorbs quickly. I like the pump but I feel like I have to pump a few times to get a good amount for my face so it might not last as long.

avis.titre: Seems like it would be amazing, but my skin was not a fan
avis.texte: I was kindly gifted the Perricone MD High Potency Hyaluronic Intensive Hydrating Serum in exchange for an honest review. This serum is designed with 4 forms and 2 natural building blocks of hyaluronic acid to instantly replenish with essential moisture for visibly smoother, firmer and plumper skin. This fast-absorbing formula helps strengthen skin's moisture barrier, increase the feel of skin cushion and reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles for a healthy, youthful-looking appearance. Leaves skin looking and feeling soft, supple and rejuvenated. It addresses dehydration, dryness, dullness, fine lines and wrinkles. Clinical results (according to their website) show a marked difference in skin hydration, skin barrier function, skin feel and texture, dullness, fine lines and wrinkles. Count me innnn!!! I loved how it felt on my skin and it did seem like my skin looked and felt more hydrated. It absorbed quickly and felt lightweight. Unfortunately, my skin broke out in red splotches and became super itchy. I also had a bit of a reaction to the scent despite it being very subtle and almost non-existent. Super disappointed because I would have loved to use it more!
The Perricone MD high potency hyaluronic intensive hydrating serum is on the expensive side although it does seem to do the job. It isn't sticky either.

I used the entire bottle hoping I would enjoy it but I really was not impressed. It felt like a silicone based product and absorbed so poorly into my skin. I didn't notice any real results, my skin presented as greasy than hydrated. I was rather disappointed in this product.

I am really enjoying this high potency hyaluronic intensity hydrating serum. It's super lightweight. It's sensitive enough for my skin. I've been using it for about a month now and love how it's adding moisture into my skin. My only negative so far is the pump is a little hard to use and sometimes I end up using more product that I want.

I usually love this brand, and this serum is no different. It has a thicker and richer feel to it than most other serums I've tried. Upon application, it absorbs immediately into the skin, leaving it feeling softer and more hydrated. I also feel like it plumps up my skin, which softens the fine lines. The packaging is nice too. It definitely feels like a high-end product. I would recommend this brand to anyone.

avis.titre: Keeps my skin hydrated and full
avis.texte: A new one for the collection! I love perricone md products and the results they produce! I feel there is something for every need I used this one every night and it keeps my skin hydrated and full! It's a creamy serum and you only need a touch of it so it absorbs very nicely into your skin. It is actually very gentle, never irritates my skin, but yet very powerful in its results!

I absolutely love the Perricone MD High Potency Hyaluronic Intensive Hydrating Serum! The lightweight serum delivers deep long-lasting hydration leaving my skin feeling smooth and refreshed. The formula absorbs quickly without any stickiness. Highly recommend, it has become an absolute staple in my nighttime routine.

The serum is extremely potent. It is an absolute must that you add the cream to damp skin. I forgot once and used it on clean dry skin which led to a breakout. The dispenser doesn't seem to clog and comes unattached. I use it about every other day just to ensure I'm not disrupting my skin too much. It's a cute little bottle that I keep next to my face wash. I sometimes follow the product with other Perricone items for extra moisture.
A little goes a long way when it comes to this product. I felt that it was an easy application and made my skin feel plump. I didn't feel that it dried my skin out at all!

I received a complimentary sample of Perricone MD High Potency Hyaluronic Intensive Hydrating Serum from Perricone MD and Influenster in exchange for my honest review. The product comes in a glass bottle with a pump that you attach when ready for use. I did not detect any fragrance or scent. This serum is a creamy formula that glides easily over your skin leaving it silky smooth. A little bit goes a long way. I did not experience any irritation. My skin feels so good after using.

I've been using this serum for just a few weeks and immediate saw a difference in my crows feet. They are more plump and less noticeable. I don't think I've used it long enough to know if it will significantly reduce any other wrinkles but since I've noticed some immediate changes I'm hopeful. I also like that the serum doesn't irritate my skin at all, and absorbs thoroughly without any residue. It seems virtually scent free so I think it would be good for those with sensitivities.

First off, this serum is amazing. Right after applying it, my skin feels really good glowy and much more hydrated I was originally only using it at night, but after seeing how nice it made my skin feel, I started using it in the morning as well. I do think it does a great job when it comes to hydration. However, when it comes to reducing winkles and fine lines I don't think it made much of a difference. Overall, it's amazing for hydration, but not as effective for anti-aging.the price is a bit pricy but you paying for the product to keep your face hydrating so I would pay the price.

avis.titre: Great serum for  fine lines and wrinkles
avis.texte: This serum is very easy to use. I washed my face then massaged this directly onto my damp face . It absorbs quickly and doesn't feel sticky or oily. Over time you see the difference in your fine line and wrinkles as it appears to plump you skin making them less noticeable . It does not have an overwhelming scent which is good since it is in your face. Although the plumping is not instantaneous it didn't take months to see a noticeable difference. I will recommend this as I am getting compliments on my skin.

I love the texture of this. It is thick but still easy to apply and spread. I feel very hydrated after using this because of that. It doesn't have a scent and didn't cause any irritation to my skin. It layered well with my other products as well. It didn't leave my skin feeling sticky or with any residue besides plump moisturized skin. I didn't experience any breakouts either. I think the bottle is very pretty, I like that it is dark glass and the pump makes for easy dispersing. I didn't have to stick my fingers into a jar.

avis.titre: I noticed a difference in my skin's hydration after a week
avis.texte: I am a loyal user to Perricone MD products. Only they are very pricey. But worth every penny. This serum is amazing. Goes on smooth, not oily, gives a cool sensation which means you can feel your skin soaking up the hydration serum. I have both dry and oily skin in different areas and this serum takes care of all areas. Using this for 7 days I can see a difference in my skin texture. Really does work. Not bad for turning 50 years old!

I have really been enjoying using this serum! Its super moisturizing and I can really see a difference in how smooth and soft my skin is. It has also helped with the firmness as well and has made my skin feel plump. There's no fragrance to cause any sensitivity and it also hasn't caused my sensitive skin any issues with hives or breakouts. I also really like the texture of the serum and the fact that I only need two small pumps for my whole face and neck. A little goes a long way! Definitely recommend

I'm very familiar with this brand and like it a lot. I also love using Hyaluronic acid. Unfortunately, my face does NOT like niacinamide. I'm 52, with normal (formally oily) skin, and acne sensitive when it comes to skincare. Seeing that it had niacinamide as an ingredient, I went ahead and applied it twice a day. I expected a breakout, and I got an unusual one. After nearly two weeks of using this product, I loved the way my skin looked. However, as my hands rubbed my face while washing it, I could feel acne under the skin. I couldn't tell by looking at my face, but I had minor, painful acne beneath the skin. I decided to stop using it and set my red light therapy to blue light for acne. I may try using it once a day or just use it on my neck and chest, since those areas aren't sensitive to acne. I like how my face looked with this product and can definitely recommend to others. I just can't handle niacinamide for myself.

This is a really nice serum. I like the pump and the way it makes my skin feel. It has a cooling effect to it when you put it on and is moisturizing without being greasy! I would even wear it under my makeup. It has made my skin feel soft in dry Arizona. I'm not sure of the price but I might splurge to get more!

Great hydrating serum that gets the job done. Has been working well with my sensitive skin not causing any new breakouts. The serum is a little on the thicker side but it doesn't feel like it once you put it on. It is greasy and doesn't leave a residue. Love that it also comes with a screw on top and a nozzle screw on top making it easy for me traveling to not break the top nor waste product from something pushing the nozzle.

I received this product free for my honest review. I was so excited for this product, but it did not hydrate like it said it was supposed to. It is not greasy, but it also did not moisturize. It was not high potent anything. It does give a matte look, but I was expecting a more dewy drenching on my face.

Works great and worth every penny. Very light weight serum, without a residue or texture left after application. I use a cream over it as my skin can get very dry living in AZ, but it does amazing at helping my creams work deeper and more effectively. No strong smell.
I really like this serum. It goes on smooth and doesn't leave your skin feeling greasy. It has a nice pump bottle. It keeps your skin well moisturized. I would purchase this.

I use this serum in the morning and at night, followed with a moisturizing cream after. It takes about 3 pumps for me to get the amount I like to cover my face and neck. It applies easily and smoothly. It dries pretty quickly so I'm not left feeling dry or oily. I have liked using this product and hope that with time, I will see fine lines minimizing.

It has a neutral scent and the overall product design is great. I love that the pump has to be installed; that helps prevent issues of the pump being broken in transit. The product itself seems to be good for sensitive skin, even for a girl like me with rosacea. I haven't had any breakouts while using it. It absorbs well.

avis.titre: Dryness Destroyer-Sip of Serum for Face
avis.texte: I really like this product! It's been great at combating my dry weather facial skin. I have sensitive skin (rosacea) but this didn't seem to cause a breakout or bother it. I've paired it over Perricone's Neuropeptide Firming Facial Concentrate, when I really want to pamper myself. I love the hydration this serum packs without feeling greasy. It absorbs well and works seamlessly under makeup. The price is a little steep, but haven't found a serum that hasn't bothered my rosacea, caused makeup issues, or left a greasy residue. A little bit goes a long way, the 2 fluid ounces is supposed to last 3 months, but I think you could stretch the longevity by focusing only on areas where dryness tends to occur.

Packaging is on par for Perricone MD, love that it comes in a glass bottle. This product isn't cheap however it is effective. The consistency of the serum is thicker than I'm use to but it goes to show how hydrating it actually is and a little covers a lot of area.

The product inside the bottle is effective and excellent. My skin drinks it up, and it alleviates any dryness I am experiencing faster and for a longer amount of time than other products with similar claims. What I have an issue with is the packaging. The glass bottle is luxurious and reflective of the price point, but the pump is not. It feels cheap and clunky and does not come with a cap that would hep from the product from drying up in the hot of the pump.

I absolutely love this serum! It is by far the best HA serum I have used. First off, the application is very easy and the formulation is more creamy than watery, like other serums can be. It was very easy to apply and I didn't have serum dripping down my face, Ari applied it just like a cream. Also, the formulation include different molecular weights of HA, so it penetrates different layers of skin. It's such a great value for the quality. This will definitely last a while. I've been using it for about a week and I can definitely notice a difference in how it leaves my skin looking and feeling. The product absorbs quickly, which is nice if you have a longer skin care routine. Best HA serum I've ever used, will definitely be repurchasing in the future!

I received this product to try for free from Influenster, and here is my honest review! So far, I have really been liking this serum. It seems intensely hydrating- the serum comes out more like a gel cream and feels very moisturizing when applied to my skin. It sinks in quickly and feels like a good primer for moisturizer. I actually feel like I have been able to see a noticeable difference in the hydration and smoothness of my skin since using this serum! My one gripe is the packaging. It's nice and sleek, and I like the appearance, but the nozzle is very hard to push down, making it difficult to dispense the product. If the nozzle isn't completely level before you press it, it gets stuck, which is frustrating. I do like how this product utilizes a pump versus a dropper though. The thick consistency of the serum is much better suited to a pump. Other than the packaging snafu, I am really enjoying this serum so far and will continue to use it!

I. LOVE. THIS. This has made my skin so soft and smooth. The hydration is unreal. I've noticed such an improvement in my redness and irritation. It's a really nice luxurious hyaluronic acid that is unscented. I've been using tretinoin and this is helping so much. Worth every penny!!!

I love this serum so much. It's lightweight and absorbs really quickly. My skin feels hydrated and smooth the entire day. I didn't notice any redness, irritation or discomfort and I usually have sensitive skin. The bottle design is sleek and appealing and dispenses very easily. I also feel like you get a lot of product which is good because a little goes a long way.

Received this serum from Influenster to review. This brand is great for non irritation ingredients. I love the soft texture and my skin drinks this product up right away. Skin feels smooth and hydrated instantly. I don't really smell much scent which is great because I don't like scented face care products too much. This product came with a pump which you can switch to for convenience. It's in a dark glass bottle like apothecary style to preserve product longer. My skin didn't breakout at all and I don't feel any stickiness nor residue on the face. Recommend this for dry and extra dry but even combo skin like me.

avis.titre: It's barely there but you know it's working.
avis.texte: I received Perricone MD High Potency Hyaluronic Intensive Hydrating Serum from Influencer to try for free. Hip-Hip-Hooray!! This stuff is really amazing! Just two pumps of this serum covers my whole face and part of my neck. It spreads easily and absorbs so quickly I barely have to wait to apply moisturizer. It makes my skin feel great. It's also unscented and I love that. My skin looks better and I also love that!! This absorbs nicely into my skin so it doesn't feel like I have tons of stuff in it - very natural feeling for sure. The formula is non-irritating, in fact I feel that my breakouts are less than ever. This bottle lasts a good long time (I've barely used a quarter of the bottle) so I know that I won't break the bank when I add this to my beauty routine. Check this out, you won't be disappointed and your skin will thank you.

This is a nice moisturizer. You do have to use it with a damp face so I spray an essence/toner spray before using it. It sinks in nicely and and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky. It works well under other products. I do feel that it gave my skin a good amount of moisture! The packaging is nice, the pump works very well! I'd consider purchasing this myself in the future!

avis.titre: A nice feeling product but not as hydrating as I was hoping
avis.texte: My skin gets so dry in the winter so I was so excited to try this product! It has great ingredients and the packaging feels very luxe in an understated way. I didn't get any irritation from it which was promising because I have very sensitive skin. There is a scent but it is light and didn't bother me at all. The actual product seems lightweight which I guess makes sense because to me, it wasn't as intensively hydrating as I was hoping it would be. It felt great but I would use it more in the summer months when my skin isn't so dry and in need of serious hydration.

This serum leaves my skin so hydrated! It really feels more plump and less tired after several weeks of using it. The texture is a bit thick so don't apply too much. Once it is absorbed I apply my moisturizer. But I have to admit, I may have forgotten to do that a few times at night because the serum made my skin feel so good. I have a sensitive skin and it did not irritate my skin at all.

avis.titre: Hydration Boost Without the Greasy Feeling!
avis.texte: The Perricone MD High Potency Hyaluronic Intensive Hydrating Serum is basically my go-to when my skin needs a hydration boost. It's a bit thicker, but it spreads really nicely and doesn't feel greasy at all. I have rosacea, and I didn't notice any flare-ups while using it, which is a huge plus. My skin's been loving all the extra moisture during the wintertime. Now I'm just curious to see how it holds up once summer rolls around.

I really liked this serum. I have aging skin, I'm in my mid 40s and did not take care of my skin when I was younger. This serum left my skin feeling hydrated and just very nice afterwards. After a few weeks of use I felt my skin's appearance improve. I needed very little to cover my whole face! Definitely recommend!

This serum has been such a great addition to my skincare routine. In my 40s, hydration makes a big difference in how my skin looks and feels, and this one delivers. It absorbs quickly and feels lightweight, and leaves my skin noticeably smoother and more refreshed. I've been using it consistently and my skin looks more plump and healthy, especially in the mornings. It layers well with my other products and doesn't feel heavy or sticky at all. Overall, it's a simple and reliable serum that gives my skin the boost it needs.
Very nice thin serum for the face. I love how the directions tell you exactly how to apply with an upward motion. Very nice on skin and absorbs nicely.

Sadly not for me. High price -would be worth it if it worked for my skin. I broke out over and over each time I tried this. Niacinamide maybe? Or too much hydration for my combo post menopausal (surgical-I'm not that old lol) skin. A tad sticky and can pull if you use a tad too much. Grateful but honest.
The serum is good and made my skin super hydrated. I didn't notice any irritation as I sometimes do either hydrating serums. The package is nice and the pump dispenses the right amount

avis.titre: No product is wasted because it all absorbs!
avis.texte: The absorption of this serum is excellent. I don't like a greasy formula that makes me look oily and doesn't absorb but this is not that!! There's no fragrance which I prefer. There's an instant boost of hydration after applying.

avis.titre: Very absorbant and helps smooth my skin.
avis.texte: Very nice moisturizing and nourishing serum that contains hyaluronic acid. This helps provide smoother and firmer skin. My face is so soft after applying alone or before moisturizer. There is no scent and absorbs nicely!

This 2oz. bottle of hyaluronic intensive hydrating serum from Perricone MD has made my face look so much more rejuvenated. I have been trying this product for a while now and I like the results. Even with one small pump of thick serum, it gets the job done. I didn't have any skin irritation or breakouts from this formula. My skin feels so hydrated even hours later after application. My skin is more radiant, smoother, and plumper after I started using this product.
Lightweight formula that goes on smoothly and absorbs quickly. It has a light scent and did not irritate my skin. It lasted on my skin for a while.

This is my favorite hyaluronic product to date. I love that it's a thick serum. It feels wonderful on my skin and has really added a level of moisture that I didn't have before. The bottle is the perfect size and I love that it is a pump!

I am seriously impressed with how effective this serum has been. I usually struggle with seasonal dryness and occasional flaking, and this has been a total game-changer for my skin barrier. The texture is lightweight and absorbs almost instantly, leaving no sticky residue behind. One of my favorite parts is how seamlessly it layers under my moisturizer and SPF—absolutely zero pilling, which is usually my biggest complaint with hyaluronic acid serums. After regular use, my skin appears noticeably plumper and stays hydrated throughout the day. This product has earned a permanent spot in my routine!￼

avis.titre: So good for my dry skin
avis.texte: This is an awesome HA serum. It goes on with a gel like consistency, but feels weightless like a serum. I have been struggling with dry flaky skin from the dry winter air, but thus really helped repair it in less than 2 weeks. This has worked well with other skincare and makeup. The packaging is nice and I love the plastic piece that prevents the pump from releasing product. It is really good for travel. Overall, this is a wonderful, luxurious product that helped my skin a lot.

avis.titre: Easy to use and home and away
avis.texte: This high potency serum going on easily, absorbs quickly and helps keep your skin feeling hydrated and refreshed. Hylauronic acid to decrease fine lines and wrinkles, the packaging with a pump makes it easy to take with you and not miss a day of use.

I received this free for review. It claims to smooth firm and plump skin. I find that it keeps my skin relatively nice but I don't see any drastic differences. I don't think it reduces fine lines or wrinkles but maybe it could help prevent them from forming. This comes in a glass bottle with a pump that you need to attach yourself. The serum is on the thicker side and unscented which is nice. I use about two pumps for my whole face and it absorbs pretty well. Overall not much of a difference, but a nice addition to your routine.
My skin is very dry and in the winter months it's even drier. My skin looks immediately hydrated and plumper. I've been using this every morning with moisturizer. You only need 1 application per day!

Perricone MD is one of my most trusted brands. If they claim a solution, chances are they will deliver. This hyaluronic intensive hydrating serum does what it says, gives your skin some plump and comfort. It's not greasy but definitely creamy in a silky way. It isn't heavy to the point that you feel like you can't put anything else on your face. It pairs well with other types of serums and doesn't inhibit makeup application. It's a quality product that I recommend if you feel like you need a little hydration boost.

I received this product free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. This serum is so amazing. I've been using is for a few weeks and my skin just loves it. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly, and it doesn't have any sticky feeling. It gives instant hydration to my skin and leaves my skin looking noticeably plumper. My skin feels sooo soft and supple. One thing I appreciate is that it layers beautifully under my moisturizer and makeup, no pilling at all. The packaging is beautiful as well and the pump dispenses the right amount. I'll keep using it!

avis.titre: The best body oil ever, a must have in your beauty and sk...
avis.texte: This is such a fascinating body oil , it's lightweight with a great scent and it makes my body feel silky smooth!! You can store in in your medicine cabinet or on top of your dresser or nightstand so you can apply a few drops to those really dry areas before you go to sleep so it can sink in and work its magic while Your sleeping!!! It's very easy to dispense and put on any part of your body that you are in need of a little skin TLC!!! I highly recommend this product, the brand is well known and highly recommended and trusted!! The size of the bottle is great because you can fit it in your purse or even your gym bag to apply some after your workout at the gym after you take a nice hot shower and rinse all that sweat off you can apply this body oil and it absorbs instantly and feels silky smooth and smells great and high a lightweight feel on your skin. I apply a few drops around my eyes and my laugh and frown lines and forehead lines before I go to bed so it seeps in through the night and when I wake up my face looks and feels refreshed!!!
This product is a great addition to My routine, it's gives me smooth skin and plumps it up nicely. No irritation or strong scents. However, I don't know if it's the end all be all of skin products.

Deeply hydrating without feeling tacky I love how it just sinks right in. I can see myself buying this in the future during winter months along with a few other of their products I've tried recently. This is a must try skin care line.

avis.titre: Great part to my morning and night routine!
avis.texte: I love the glass bottle!!! The dispenser is very easy to use and product is a very nice texture. Great consistency of the serum and goes on so well in the skin. After I wash my face I use the hydrating serum and it makes my face feel so soft and hydrating. It doesn't leave me feeling sticky or oily. Highly recommend!

Perricone MD High Potency Hyaluronic Intensive Hydrating Serum is a must have to any woman's morning skincare routine. Light weight, smooth, fast absorption and easy application are some of the most important features to know about this product. Instant hydration and soothing effects felt immediately. My skin looks and feels so taken care of since using this serum. Excited to try more products from Perricone MD as soon as possible.

This is the third Perricone product I've tried and they all are winners! This hydrating serum is fantastic. The smell is subtle, but really nice. The consistency is perfect for gliding all over your face and neck easily. As for the hydration? It is off the charts! I have very dry skin that gets tight and uncomfortable after washing and this was the remedy I needed! It is nourishing, calming, and super duper hydrating! 10/10 stars ⭐️

This is a really good product. It didn't irritate my sensitive skin and left it feeling plump and hydrated. It pairs well with the rest of my skincare routine and doesn't pill under makeup. I would definitely recommend this product and buy it again.

The Perricone MD High Potency Hyaluronic Intensive Hydrating Serum is such an amazing product. This product is lightweight, creamy, and absorbs easily. It is so hydrating, which is very much needed during the winter months. My skin has a lot of problems, but dryness is one that I struggle with a lot, so this was a really hydrating addition to my routine that actually helped with volume and fine lines. I have areas of my face that sag a little, due to my age, but my skin looked really plump while using this serum. Just look at my picture!! I would absolutely buy this product again and highly recommend it!

I received this product free in exchange for my honest opinion. I enjoy this hyaluronic serum because of how thick it is. Other hyaluronic serums are so runny and it feels like it takes a while for them to absorb. This is thicker and really sets into my skin. It works well with my other skincare and doesn't pill.

avis.titre: If you are dry, then it's a must have
avis.texte: I have naturally dry skin, and since using this product I feel like my skin looks much more plump. I use it in my skin care routine in the morning and I feel like my makeup goes on even smoother than usual. I think this is a must have product for all of us dry skin type!

This is the second Perricone product I've tried recently, and once again it did not disappoint. I worked for a company over a decade ago that produced hyaluronic acid, so I pay close attention to formulations and Perricone really did their homework here. The blend of HA ingredients, especially the use of bio fermentation-derived, which is more effective and easier for skin to absorb, is thoughtfully done. As a skincare junkie, I consistently find that this brand delivers on ingredient quality every time. I've been using this serum twice daily for the past couple of weeks and have been really enjoying it. It's unscented, and a little goes a long way. It layers beautifully under makeup, smoothing my skin without pilling. I'm not sure if this was intentional by the brand, but I really liked that the product was packaged with a screw on-cap, in addition to the pump. That makes it more travel-friendly than any of my other serums! I received this product for free from Influenster and Perricone in exchange for my honest review.
This product works really good on your face. My face immediately felt smoother and looked smoother after a few uses. This really helped repair my skin from these harsh winter months.

I absolutely love this fragrance free hydrating serum which is a magical potion to my skin. This winter has made my skin unbelievably dry. Using this serum has made it look and feel so supply and smooth! I saw a difference from day 1. It also doesn't clog pores and cause acne - which is fantastic! I also used it on other parts of my body - hands and cracked heels. It was magical, it immediately hydrated my skin.

I've been really impressed with Perricone MD High Potency Hyaluronic Intensive Hydrating Serum. The texture is lightweight and silky, it absorbs quickly, and does not leave my skin feeling greasy or sticky. My skin immediately feels hydrated and smooth. After using it consistently, I noticed my skin looks more plump and refreshed, especially since my skin can be so dry. It layers great under my makeup. This makes it easy to add to my beauty routine. A little goes a long way! I love that this serum makes my skin look healthy and hydrated. My skin is so soft! This serum delivers moisture and makes my skin look radiant!

avis.titre: Nice addition to the daily skin care routine!
avis.texte: Super lightweight formula that doesn't feel greasy or heavy. I've used it in the morning only, but it does say to use morning & night. My makeup goes on nicely over the serum. It has no fragrance that I can smell. It has a very soft and velvety finish. No irritation or anything like that. The 4/5 stars is because I haven't noticed any visible changes since I've started using it. I haven't noticed anything significant at all. But I do like it as a moisturizer! I'd recommend using it!

This product feels like a gel. It applies easily and dries down matte. It almost feels like applying a silicone primer. It locks in moisture without leaving my face looking shiny and doesn't leave a residue. It hasn't caused any breakouts. My skin feels softer and has started looking my plump and hydrated since using.

avis.titre: Lightweight but good dose of moisture
avis.texte: This is such a lightweight almost cream/gel versus a serum the delivers a good amount of moisture but it isn't heavy at all so it is perfect underneath makeup and other skincare. I didn't really notice any improvement to my fine lines or wrinkles but I will continue to use this daily as my moisturizer underneath makeup as the weather gets warmer.

I love this hydrating serum. I love how the serum keeps my skin hydrated all day. I can apply it in the morning and it mast until I clean my face at night. It has a nice clean scent thst is not over powering. It comes in a nice bottle. I highly recommend this.
I love this serum! It goes on smooth and feels great. Light weight and I don't notice any stickiness. I have sensitive skin and this serum has not caused any issues. I highly recommend it.

I am in my mid to late thirties, with combination and sensitive skin. I have really been enjoying this serum so far. My skin looks and feels soft and hydrated while using this. It doesn't have much of a smell and it absorbs quickly into the skin. I haven't had any bad reactions or break outs from this at all. My biggest issue is actually the packaging. The pump is super janky and kind of a pain and considering the price I expect a better pump. While I like this product I don't know that it's worth the price for me. There are other, more affordable brands that perform just about as well as this one. But if it's in your budget and you want to treat yo self it's a good serum.

avis.titre: Great Hydration with a Lightweight Feel
avis.texte: The Perricone MD High Potency Hyaluronic Intensive Hydrating Serum is a great option that leaves skin feeling smooth and refreshed. My skin looked pumped after using which made adding makeup on after a breeze. It is a great value since a little goes a long way.

Both serum bottle and pump are included in the box for assembly when you open it. The serum itself is creamy, not gel or oily like some others. It goes on smooth, soaks in quickly and nicely, leaving no sticky feeling. Skin feels clean and ready for your next step in moments, which is a great reason not to skip this step when you're in a hurry but also is a fresh clear feeling before bed if used for nighttime hydration. I love that it's unscented because I can be sensitive to things that are too perfumed or compete with the scent I choose to wear. I've used this brand before and have been pleased. This product is no different!

I love this hydrating serum! It's slightly thicker and opaque, which I really like. It applies smoothly and makes my skin feel immediately hydrated and plump. It absorbs well and quickly, so that I can apply moisturizer after. It makes my skin feel so soft!
Really loving this product. Goes on nice and smooth. No fragrance. Makes my skin feel good and moisturized for the day. Have really noticed a difference
This product is super hydrating! I like to use it after I skin flood with toners to seal in all the products I've applied and let them really sink in.

It's just an ok product. For the price you can find a better solution for combination skin, even Olay offers a better hydration. Have used Dr P in the past and am disappointed by the price size and results (none).

This serum left my skin very hydrated. I use it after I wash my face and before a moisturizer and only at night. I supposed you can use it during the day too but I figured night time is when I put on a whole skin care regimen and has time to massage it in and let it absorb and dry before layering on other products. It's more a matter of convenience for me. It didn't irritate my sensitive skin either which is great.

avis.titre: Skin feels hydrated, soft, and refreshed!
avis.texte: I've been using the Perricone MD High Potency Hyaluronic Intensive Hydrating Serum and really like it. It has an easy to use pump, it goes on silky smooth and absorbs quickly into my skin with no sticky feeling. It feels perfect under makeup too. My skin feels hydrated, soft, and refreshed after using it. What I love the most is that there is no fragrance! Yes!! Which means no irritation for my sensitive skin, which makes it even better for everyday use!
Very nice. It is lightweight and absorb quickly without feeling sticky, consistency is good. My skin feels more hydrated. The packaging is high quality.

avis.titre: I love how my skin feels after using this product
avis.texte: I absolutely love this Perricone MD hyaluronic hydrating serum. It comes in a glass bottle with a pump for easy dispensing. I've been using it daily for several weeks and the results feel amazing. For reference I'm 43 yrs old with lots of freckles. I have been out in the sun a lot so my freckles are getting darker. My skin feels so smooth. I mist my face with a spray bottle of water because it says to apply to damp skin. Then it rubs in smooth. It doesn't feel sticky and dries very quickly. My skin feels so hydrated. I've always had oily skin and ai feel like this has also helped with my oily forehead. It doesn't have any perfumes or scent. I've had zero irritation or break outs. I will continue to purchase this after my bottle runs out. I love how my face and neck feel after using this product.

The serum delivers exactly what it promises- lightweight hydration that layers seamlessly under makeup. The texture absorbs so quickly you are not left with any tackiness and it does not pill when paired with foundation or sunscreen. The glass bottle is an obvious choice to preserve the integrity of the formula which is good to know compared to the typical plastic ones. This is definitely hydrating without the heaviness. Love it

The bottle is really nice. Thick glass with a nice pump and even a pump guard so you can take it when you travel and not worry about it leaking. The product itself is thicker then most serums, no fragrance and goes on so smooth. My skin soaked it up and was left so soft and moisturized. It is not heavy on your skin and overall worked great. Highly recommend this for your skin care routine if you need that little extra moisture.

avis.titre: This serum makes my skin feel hydrated, smooth, and refre...
avis.texte: I've been using the Perricone MD High Potency Hyaluronic Intensive Hydrating Serum for a while now and I really like it! My skin feels a lot more hydrated and smoother since I started using it. It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave my face feeling greasy or sticky. A little goes a long way and it layers well under my moisturizer and makeup. I've noticed my skin looks healthier and more refreshed overall. If you're looking for something to help with dryness and give your skin a nice boost of hydration, this serum is definitely worth trying!

Love how light and easy it was to apply the serum and the all over glow it gave me instantly. That glow lasted a few hours post application, though I did it in the evening and did not put anything else on my skin until my nighttime moisturizer. It did not give me a greasy feeling and there was no scent. I have been using it for two weeks now and find my skin is nice and supple and hydrated! Pricey, but a little does look go a long way.

This is one of my favorite skin care lines. This is a good hydration product for mature skin. I like to use it with other products from this same line. It is not the least expensive but you are paying for the quality and you don't need to use a lot to get results

This is the second time I have tried a Perricone MD product and I'm a big fan. The scent of this serum is really nice, it has helped my skin stay hydrated and decrease the size of my pores. It doesn't leave a sticky residue so it didn't cause any issues with my foundation. The packaging is nice and the dispenser worked perfectly. I will definitely purchase this product.

I was impressed with this serum. It has a nice silky texture that quickly and easily absorbs into my skin. The first time I used it my skin was a little irritated for a few hours. Thankfully I haven't had any other issues like that. I just made sure to use a little less and that seemed to help with the irritation. The serum has helped my skin look and feel more hydrated. I prefer to use it in the evening before I go to bed. I didn't like how it made my foundation look. Overall I'd say it's a nice product worth trying.

So I haven't seen any results yet, I have only been using it for a week or so. I do however really enjoy how it feels when it dries down. It feels like it sorta dried down like it was wet. I have not smelled anything from this which is wonderful. I have experienced a little irritation but I am pushing through. Concentration is great.

avis.titre: Lightweight but gave me a rash
avis.texte: I used this for about 3 days in a row and got a slight rash. I think it could be the 1,2-hexanediol unfortunately — wish this was made without it! Other than that, it feels like a light formula. It didnt make my skin look SUPER hydrated (I have dry skin) and wouldnt have minded more plumping. I'd love to be able to use it more guess it will need to go on my chest.

Thank you Influencer for sending me this Perricone MD Hyaluronic Intensive Hydrating Serum. I was so excited for this one I heard some good stuff about it. Packaging is very nice minimal & kinda cute . I love the consistency & doesn't have any smell for me it's just smell amazing I been using it past 3 weeks & small amount go far … I'm seeing results in my skin tone & I have kinda dry skin it moisture my skin well I used it every night after my skin care routine.. it's durable & pump out just perfect amount / dosage .. I'm very pleased & will be hooked on this product.

Received product for free for honest review. The pump that came in box is faulty but the actual product is fabulous. Use twice a day. Absorbs quickly and is non greasy. I use before using my Perricone moisturizer. I have noticed an improvement in my face and skin. Smooths out my facial lines and hydrates my face and neck well. Just the lightest of barely there scent to product. Thrilled to have been able to trial this and plan to purchase in future. Fabulous for my aging skin.

This is a miracle serum!! I saw a difference in a week! Oh my life people about these commented on how nice my skin was as we get older things change you go through things and it shows on your skin and that's what was starting to happen to me shortly after my mom's death this past May. I was sent this product a test and I am definitely a believer now. It was easy to apply it literally slips right into your skin. I cannot even describe the feeling it doesn't feel greasy or heavy and it doesn't have a strong odor.. I have started to see lines around my eyes and on either side of my nose and this gave me so much more volume in my skin. It really is an amazing product. It is definitely when I will be continuing to use.

This product is a 50/50 for me. The High Potency Hyaluronic Intensive Hydrating Serum is something I wanted to love. I've used several other, of varying price points, hyaluronic products over the years with success. I thought this would work great for me as I am in my 40s and I do routinely use serums in my daily and nightly skincare routine. While this has a lovely consistency, no scent at all and it absorbs beautiful on my face, my neck and chest are a different story. If you're like me, you bring all of your products down to your chest however this breaks me out on my neck and chest but not on my face. I've tried it multiple times and it is certainly the culprit unfortunately. I do like the benefits I get from using it on my face. It pairs well with makeup, spf and my other skincare. I like it so much that I have just been more carefully about where I apply it. For the price, I don't think I can justify repurchasing if I'm having breakouts on my neck/chest but I highly recommend it if you aren't someone with a little more sensitive skin.
Love the texture of this serum! Goes on so smoothly and leaves my skin plump. Gives me no irritation. It is a nice size bottle so it will last you awhile. Great skin loving ingredients too.
